text:
alex: quick standup — yesterday I finished the AZ tagging fix and re-run the eu-west1 capacity calc. noticed ~10% shortfall if the new model rollout hits peak qps. blocker: waiting on quota reply from cloud for additional GPUs. today: filing INF-3245 to request +12 GPUs in eu-west1 and will kick off a small canary.

tara: thanks @alex. yesterday: deployed gating for prewarm flows. blockers: seeing intermittent `kv-cache overflow` errors (~2% p50->p90 spread). opened PR #789 with extra logging. today: triaging logs and planning to throttle prewarm if error rate spikes. :mag:

mike: FYI ap-southeast1 had 3 spot evictions overnight, autoscaler recovered but we saw ~30s tail. filed a short incident with cloud support (CS-998). no blockers. i'll run a failover test at 14:30 PT — @jen can you stand by for routing checks?

jen: on standby for 14:15. also added a temporary routing rule to shift gen-heavy traffic to eu-west1 until we confirm capacity. merged a small policy tweak to routing. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: scheduled maintenance notice — draining node gke-ops-04 in ap-southeast1 at 2026-03-18T23:00Z. impacted pods will be cordoned and evicted. link: https://console.cloud.example/maintenance/ops-04

alex: quick ask — can we get an expedited quota bump? INF-3245 has justification and perf numbers. @mike can you attach the eviction logs and perf snapshot? :pray:

mike: added the eviction logs and a perf snapshot to INF-3245. also pinged our cloud rep. diagnostics i ran: ```gcloud compute instances list --filter='zone:asia-southeast1' && kubectl describe node gke-ops-04```

tara: i'll keep an eye on prewarm errors while we scale. if `kv-cache overflow` goes above 3% i'll toggle the fallback to the cacheless path to avoid user-visible failures.

jen: also merging PR #790 that reduces batch timeout from 200ms -> 150ms, should reduce tail latency and help packing. cc @alex

alex: SGTM. if quota isn't approved by EOD i'll flip non-critical routes to the smaller model as a temporary fallback and update the runbook. thanks all.
